summary: W2 is close but does not pass round 1. One done-criterion fails its own gate: done 9, the ledger line re-renders only on change. `node _harness/hud_renders.mjs --at 100` exits 1 with SkyLedger at 4 renders for 1 number change over 180 ticks. The cause is that SkyLedger is a plain child of SkyStrip, so it re-renders every time SkyStrip does (3 times in that window). HUD-4 is therefore only partly done. The other 10 done-criteria and the other 13 blocker/major items hold on fresh runs: e2e flow, e2e rift, the 720p sweep through a real Co-op queue, icon_probe, probe_audio_qpop and the session/online/content probes. I also checked every new image by eye at full size and with 3-4x head crops; all pass sensitivity and every figure matches a roster model. Two minor items are not connected end to end. (a) The Settings > Audio 'Soften loud sounds' toggle writes audio.softenLoud, but W3's engine reads audio.soften, so the toggle does nothing. (b) AUD-m2: the UI calls AudioPort.draft(), but W3's engine only has musicPhase()/musicUrgency(), so the draft urgency layer never turns on from the UI. I found no ownership violations and no W2-file regressions: typecheck is clean, content:check is OK with 1 known warning, and probe_content_ids only fails in src/audio (W3).

_harness/_reports/fw_W2_v1r_hud_renders.json and .err/.exit: `hud_renders.mjs --at 100` gives EXIT 1, 'HUD-4 ledger FAIL: renders 4, changes 1' over 180 ticks / 6 s; the gate allows renders <= changes+1. The line is on screen ('T/F/A0/0/0·Wicks4', 13px Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, box 1116,72 184x20). Cause: SkyLedger is a plain child of SkyStrip (src/ui/hud/top.tsx:58 and :79). SkyStrip rendered 3 times in the window, and each parent render re-renders SkyLedger even though its useViewKey key did not change. The engineers' two passing runs had 0 changes and 0 parent renders, so they never exercised this.
items.fixHint: In src/ui/hud/top.tsx, keep SkyLedger out of SkyStrip's re-renders. Either wrap it in memo() from 'preact/compat' (it takes no props, so memo(SkyLedger) skips parent re-renders), or mount it as a sibling of SkyStrip under the HUD root and position it with CSS. Then re-run `node _harness/hud_renders.mjs --at 100` and `--at 160` until renders <= changes+1.

items.evidence: The UI writes audio.softenLoud (src/session/settings.ts:35,:122; src/ui/screens/settings.tsx:175-176). src/ui/app.tsx:68 forwards state.settings.value.audio unchanged to the engine. W3's engine reads `soften` (src/audio/index.ts:140-142 `mono?: boolean; soften?: boolean`, :437 `const soften = !!this.vol.soften`). So 'Soften loud sounds' never reaches the engine. Mono works because the names match.
items.fixHint: Pick one name. Either in src/ui/app.tsx:68 (W2) pass `{ ...s.audio, soften: (s.audio as AudioSettings).softenLoud === true }`, or hand off to W3 to read `softenLoud` in src/audio/index.ts AudioSettings. Then check window.__valeAudio.access.soften === true after toggling the setting.

items.evidence: draft.tsx sends DraftMusicState through AudioPort.draft() (src/ui/audio_port.ts:68, :111 `inner?.draft?.(s)`). The engine passed in by src/boot/main.ts:59 has no draft() method; grep finds only musicPhase(phase) and musicUrgency(on) at src/audio/index.ts:167-169 and :538-540. So the draft bed's phase layers fall back to the engine's own 16 s / 80 s walk, and the local 8 s urgency layer is never switched on from the UI.
items.fixHint: In src/ui/app.tsx or audio_port.ts (W2), adapt draft(s) for an engine that has musicPhase/musicUrgency: musicPhase(s ? (s.phase === 'ban' ? null : s.phase === 'pick' ? 'picks' : 'final') : null) and musicUrgency(!!s?.urgent). Call it after music('mus_draft') because musicPhase resets on a bed change. The layer ids are phase_picks, phase_final and urgency in content/audio.json mus_draft. Alternatively W3 adds draft(s) to the engine. Verify with window.__valeAudio.log showing the urgency layer during the last 8 s of your pick.
